messages:

Cc: Ops Procurement <ops@global-retail.com>, Elena Morales <elena@procurement-portal.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Timeline and final paper routing for Q3 pilot

Nikhil,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. We're aligned on scope and performance targets, but procurement needs a tight, executable timeline so we can schedule our internal kickoff and IT approvals. Two things we need from Redwood to close this week:

1) A clear signature cadence (who signs, when, and whether DocuSign is acceptable).
2) A final preferred start date window for the pilot that accounts for your internal provisioning (we'd like to start no later than the first week of July).

Can you send a proposed paperflow + MAP with signature windows and a preferred execution date? Also flag any outstanding security artifacts — our security team will want SOC2 evidence and the data flow diagram attached to the contract attachments.

Thanks,
Andrew
Andrew Baker
Director, Strategic Ops
Global Retail, Inc.

--
Proceedings attached elsewhere

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Andrew Baker <andrew.baker@global-retail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-21T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Timeline and final paper routing for Q3 pilot

Andrew — thanks, agreed this needs to be tight. Putting proposed routing and execution window below and attaching the MAP (MAP-v3.1.pdf) and SOC2 pointer.

High-level proposal (paperflow + execution window):
- Week 1 (5/25–5/29): Redwood legal uploads the final contract with the redline accepted items. Internal review by Global Retail procurement.
- Week 2 (6/1–6/5): Final countersign and electronic signature window (DocuSign preferred). We can do staggered signing: Redwood (AM) signs first, then Global Retail legal/procurement sign within 48 hours.
- Week 3 (6/8–6/12): Provisioning & dedicated capacity reservation. Runbook handoff to IT/ops for network whitelisting.
- Target pilot start window: Monday 6/15 or Tuesday 6/16 (preferred), latest 06/22 if procurement requires extra time.

Key notes:
- Signature method: DocuSign works for both parties. If GR requires physical signatures, we can accommodate but that will push start date out by 7–10 days.
- Attachments: MAP-v3.1.pdf (includes mutual action items and owners), SOC2-evidence.zip (pointer to our SOC2 report), Signature-Table.xlsx (we'll circulate signer list and emails).
- Approvals required: Redwood AE (me), Redwood Legal (cc'd internally), Global Retail Procurement + General Counsel.

Next steps:
- Olga (Redwood Legal) — can you confirm the final clause edit that procurement flagged yesterday (data-retention clause) and confirm DocuSign is OK?
- Laura — I'll need a CS rep on the kickoff; can you confirm availability for provisioning week (6/8–6/12)?

I'll stand by to upload the Doc for signatures once legal confirms.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: MAP-v3.1.pdf, SOC2-evidence.zip

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-22T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Timeline and final paper routing for Q3 pilot

All — reviewed procurement's redline. Two quick legal items that will affect the paperflow:

1) Data retention clause: procurement suggested a 7-year retention cap. We can accept retention controls but need a scoped exception for transient inference caches and customer-configurable retention. Suggested language (I'll paste in the doc): "Customer data stored for inference is retained only per customer-configured retention settings; transient model caches are excluded from long-term retention obligations."

2) SLA & kickout clause: Finance and Legal want a fallback clause in the MAP that allows a two-week operational review before ramp if live latency regresses beyond the agreed SLA. This is not a blocker for signature but should be acknowledged in the cover email so procurement can triage.

DocuSign: we are fine using DocuSign. Please populate Signature-Table.xlsx with signer names, titles, and emails. Karthik — can you take ownership of the signature table and format it for DocuSign envelope order?

I will attach a redlined contract pdf to the DocuSign envelope. Once signatures are routed we'll keep a stamped copy in our contract repository and push final start-date to engineering.

Olga Petrov
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai

Attachment referenced: Signature-Table.xlsx (please update)
